title: Implement XML comment capture in xmltodict at pinned v0.12.0
goal: Clone https://github.com/martinblech/xmltodict into work/gc-337/repo (relative to the benchmark repo root) and check out pinned commit e561fcc42c5bc754e4156003e6717065d7484225 (release tag v0.12.0); the grader verifies that HEAD equals this exact commit, so keep all repairs as uncommitted working-tree edits to non-test source files. At this commit xmltodict.parse() rejects a process_comments keyword. The sealed tests require parse(..., process_comments=True) to expose XML comments as stripped '#comment' entries at the correct nesting level, while default parsing and unparse round-trips stay unchanged. Decompose the work into a written plan, run the grader command first to record the initial RED state and the identities of the failing sealed tests, implement incrementally, and re-run the exact grader command after each increment until all 5 sealed tests pass. Do not edit or shadow anything under assets/gc-337/: the grader re-copies the sealed tests from assets over the workspace and disables pytest plugin autoloading and conftest collection, so test tampering cannot turn the run GREEN.

spec.command: git config --global --add safe.directory '*' && test "$(git -C work/gc-337/repo rev-parse HEAD)" = "e561fcc42c5bc754e4156003e6717065d7484225" && pip -q install pytest==8.2.2 && pip -q install --no-deps ./work/gc-337/repo && rm -rf work/gc-337/sealed_run && mkdir -p work/gc-337/sealed_run && cp assets/gc-337/tests/*.py work/gc-337/sealed_run/ && cd work/gc-337/sealed_run && PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python -m pytest -q --noconftest -p no:cacheprovider .

process_expectations: A written repair plan exists at work/gc-337/notes/plan.md before the first source edit, naming the target module(s) and the sealed tests each step is meant to turn green.
The grader command was executed once before any source change and its RED output (failing sealed test identities, not just counts) is preserved verbatim in the run log.
A running log at work/gc-337/notes/attempts.md maps each code iteration to the specific sealed test identities it targeted and what the re-verification run returned.
After any RED re-verification the next diff is traceable to a named failing test, not a blind full rewrite; abandoned approaches are recorded rather than deleted.
An honest cost/time ledger covering all attempts, including failed ones, is kept alongside the notes.
